costs.model: programme cost model per the SRS holdout addendum recorded reading (frozen there, adopted here): simulator.Costs() as shipped — 5 bps fee + 3 bps spread/slippage per side applied adversely in price space = 16 bps round trip at 1x; the 2x shadow is the identical simulation at 32 bps round trip
costs.note: A futures-venue cost model applied to equities — noted, not hidden; it is the model the programme names and is not generous to the strategy. The declared borrow charge comes on top for shorts.

data_plan.dividend_calendar: Alpaca corporate-actions announcements for the 30 names over the span (cash dividends: ex-date + amount); used only for the declared dividend adjustment
gate_5_checks: 1. Session census: each symbol's bar count equals the panel session count (961 expected) or every shortfall is itemised by date with a named cause; unexplained gaps fail the gate.
2. SIP feed check: every symbol's median daily share volume over the span >= 2,000,000 shares (panel-level form of the SRS SIP-vs-IEX check).

3. Split check: split-adjusted continuity on known in-span split ex-dates (WMT 3:1 2024-02-26; NVDA 10:1 2024-06-10; AVGO 10:1 2024-10-14) — no overnight close-to-close move approximating the split ratio; any single-session |close-to-close return| > 40% anywhere must be itemised with a named cause.

4. Cross-source spot check: >= 10 sampled symbol-sessions across symbols and years including one split ex-date week: closes within $0.02 and highs/lows within $0.05 vs Yahoo Finance daily (the SRS addendum v3 cross-source).
5. Dividend calendar check: >= 10 sampled ex-dates cross-checked vs Yahoo dividend history — dates exact, amounts within $0.005; full calendar (count + SHA-256) frozen into the provenance record.
data_plan.gate_rule: ALL five checks must pass before any backtest; a panel that fails verification is not run and consumes zero trials
data_plan.keys: installed with the SRS execution through the normal credential channel; this declaring package neither has nor seeks them; the pull happens at run time, not now
data_plan.licence_handling: raw panel never committed to the public repo (SIP licence); only the provenance record (parameters, per-symbol counts, SHA-256 of panel + dividend calendar) is committable, per SRS practice
data_plan.run_procedure: (1) harness verified against this declaration; mechanics debugging on synthetic bars or the pre-OOS segment only. (2) pull and gate the panel; failure stops the run. (3) execute the frozen code ONCE over the full panel; hash-pin each cell's trade list (SHA-256) in the run record before any metric is computed. (4) compute D-segment and pooled metrics not requiring H. (5) evaluate H (H1-H4) exactly once. (6) report pass or fail in full, including mandatory leg-split reporting.
data_plan.source: Alpaca Market Data, Basic plan ($0), historical daily bars, feed=sip (consolidated CTA+UTP tape; IEX carries ~2.7% of consolidated volume and is rejected), adjustment=split — the SRS-adjudicated spec
data_plan.span: 2023-01-01 -> 2026-10-31 (requests start=2023-01-01T00:00:00Z, end=2026-11-01T00:00:00Z); 961 NYSE sessions per SRS provenance research (374 pre-OOS + 587 OOS)

declared_conventions.dividend_adjustment: Data bars are adjustment=split (the SRS-adjudicated spec), so split-adjusted closes drop by approximately the dividend on each ex-date. Declared mechanical adjustment from the Alpaca corporate-actions dividend calendar for the 30 names over the span: (a) ranking scores add back in-window dividends per the score formula; (b) a trade spanning an ex-date (ex-date in (entry session, exit session]) has net return adjusted by +div/entry_price (long) or -div/entry_price (short, payment in lieu). Approximations declared: announced amount, not the realised ex-date drop; tax/withholding ignored. If the dividend calendar cannot be obtained and verified at the gate, the run does not proceed.
declared_conventions.leg_reporting: The run record must state pooled OOS expectancy and PF at 1x costs for (a) the full book, (b) the LONG leg only, (c) the SHORT leg only. The bar judges (a) only.
declared_conventions.position_sizing: Not part of this family's identity; the bar judges per-trade expectancy / profit factor (sizing-invariant); positions equal-notional within a cohort by construction of the return accounting. If a cell ever reaches forward testing it inherits the fleet-standard decided risk package (FWD-006) unchanged — 0.1% of venue equity risk per trade, 2% heat cap per strategy with this whole book counting as one strategy — as recorded for SRS and S-RD1.
declared_conventions.short_borrow: Borrow is not historically observable from free data. Declared charge on every SHORT trade: net_return -= 0.0025 * (calendar days from entry date to exit date)/360 (25 bps per annum ACT/360, a general-collateral assumption for this mega/large-cap universe), applied identically at 1x and 2x cost levels (the shadow doubles transaction costs only). Locate failures, short-sale circuit breakers and recalls are NOT modelled — disclosed; the borrow charge plus mandatory separate short-leg reporting are the compensation.

evaluation_bar.cost_shadow: pooled OOS at 32 bps round trip (borrow unchanged): expectancy_net > 0 AND profit_factor_net >= 1.2 (fold/holdout/significance elements judged at 1x only — declared resolution of the programme's 'both passing' phrasing)
evaluation_bar.folds: >= 4 of 5 folds with positive expectancy_net, trades present in >= 4 folds (rd2.stats2.check_bar2 construction)
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only; entry-time fold attribution under walkforward.FOLDS (W1 2024-07-01->2025-01-01, W2 ->2025-07-01, W3 ->2026-01-01, W4 ->2026-07-01, W5 ->2026-11-01, end exclusive); pre-OOS 2023-01-01->2024-06-30 is warm-up/in-sample reporting only, never blended; parameters frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample
evaluation_bar.panel_holdout: rd2.stats2.holdout2 passes: breadth >= 50% of symbols with >= 20 OOS trades positive; no single symbol > 50% of total positive profit; untouched subset sorted(universe)[2::3] pooled expectancy > 0 on >= 30 trades; >= 3 active symbols
evaluation_bar.pooled_oos: expectancy_net > 0 AND profit_factor_net >= 1.2 AND >= 200 pooled OOS trades; if pooled OOS trades < 200 the cell's verdict is exactly 'insufficient OOS trades' (not proven, not a pass, not a deletion; the bar is never relaxed)
evaluation_bar.significance: Bonferroni one-sided p < 0.05/N_final on the per-trade mean (rd2.stats2.trade_stats construction) at the FINAL global trial counter at judgement time. Deflated Sharpe ratio is REPORTED, not judged: RD-002's DSR gate was a synthesis-time construction over a 1,441-trial population (sr_std = cross-trial Sharpe dispersion) that a 2-cell family cannot support; SRS and S-RD1 likewise judge significance by Bonferroni alone. The run record states the DSR (sr_std across this family's two cells) for the record; no verdict turns on it.
evaluation_bar.source: Stratex/rigorous_backtest/rd2/stats2.py BAR + check_bar2 + holdout2 + significance practice; SRS declaration bar; SRS TEMPORAL HOLDOUT v1 (frozen SHA-256 69d9dcefd553bb11a18cd3d2aa7ecb5d187f901ec3c3cebbe84ebc373926f7e4)
evaluation_bar.temporal_holdout: SRS TEMPORAL HOLDOUT v1 H1-H4 adopted for this family (H = trades entered in W5; D = trades entered in W1-W4): H1 |H| >= 20; H2 expectancy_net(H) > 0; H3 expectancy_net(D) > 0; H4 no single fold > 80% of summed positive fold profit; H5 burn clause adopted in effect verbatim — W5 judged exactly once in the single declared run; prior inspection of W5 trades/metrics, or any re-run with any change after evaluation, burns the holdout and this element FAILS permanently under this declaration; |H| < 20 fails as FAIL (INSUFFICIENT_HOLDOUT_TRADES), window never extended. On any disagreement with TEMPORAL HOLDOUT v1, the stricter reading governs.
evaluation_bar.verdict_mapping: all elements pass -> cell PASSES, forward-test candidate only (Phase-3: >= 100 demo trades AND >= 8 weeks, demo only). >= 200 OOS trades and PF_net < 1.2 -> cell FAILS; both cells fail -> family DELETED (closed) under the owner's rule. 'Proven' is reserved for a cell passing everything.

hypothesis: On a frozen 30-name panel of large, continuously listed US common stocks, the judged xs_reversal construction (trailing 5- or 10-session return ranking, long bottom-3 / short top-3, 5-session rebalance, 2/4 ATR bracket, 5-session cap) earns positive expectancy net of the programme cost model — driven by liquidity-provision reversal around the overnight boundary and auction imbalances — sufficient to clear the full programme bar.

lineage.counterweight: The prior from the judged panels is negative. The argument above is a reason the question is open, not evidence for a pass. The bar is the programme bar, unchanged. If both cells fail, the family is closed on equities too, permanently; no third panel, no parameter variant.
lineage.equity_coverage: Never run on any equity or index panel. No cross-sectional ranker appears on an equity panel anywhere in RD-001..RD-017; RD-008 judged single-series systems (ema_cross, tsmom, donchian, gap_daily, gap_intra, zrev, rsi_rev) on SPX/NDX index series, which is not a cross-section.
lineage.judged_construction: score = close/close.shift(L) - 1; rank panel; long lowest scorers, short highest (long_low=True); rebalance 5 bars; k=3 per side; exits bracket_time SL 2.0xATR(14) / TP 4.0xATR(14) / max_bars 5; variants rev5_r5 (L=5), rev10_r5 (L=10); classes [crypto, forex, comm]; timeframes 1d/4h
lineage.judged_family: RD-002 batch 3 family xs_reversal (pre-declared in Stratex/rigorous_backtest/results_rd2/batch3_declaration.json; implemented in rd2/families3.py::xs_reversal_fn)
lineage.judged_verdict: 12 rows, ALL FAIL. crypto30 1d: rev5_r5 1,020 OOS trades, expectancy -0.169%, PF 0.957, 2/5 folds positive; rev10_r5 PF 0.945. Family best: rev5_r5@comm7 1d PF 1.196 (708 trades), still below the 1.2 bar. The mechanism stands DELETED (owner rule: strict OOS PF < 1.2 -> DELETE) on every panel it has touched.
lineage.nature_of_this_declaration: NEW-PANEL coverage of a judged-dead mechanism — not a new mechanism, not a re-tune. The two cells below are the judged configurations transplanted unchanged (same lookbacks, rebalance, k, bracket) onto a US single-name equity panel. Equity-specific adaptations are confined to data/cost conventions (dividend adjustment, short borrow) and are declared as conventions, not mechanism changes.
why_the_equity_panel_is_a_different_ques: Short-horizon cross-sectional reversal is equity-native (Jegadeesh 1990; Lehmann 1990); its standard explanation is liquidity provision by market makers / limit-order suppliers absorbing non-informational imbalance. Crypto perpetuals (24/7, no designated market makers) lack the agent the theory credits with the effect; the judged failure measures the transplant, not the home market.

US equities have a hard daily close and overnight gaps; a material share of equity reversal is the overnight/intraday decomposition (rebound at/after the open as overnight inventory is worked off). A 24/7 series has no overnight boundary, so this component cannot exist in the judged cells — they are silent about it, not negative about it.

Opening and closing auctions concentrate US volume into two prints per session, including mechanical index/ETF rebalancing and market-on-close imbalance flow that moves prices without information — the canonical input to multi-day reversal. No judged panel has auctions.

The equity short leg is structurally different: borrow fees, locate and short-sale circuit-breaker constraints, recall risk. The judged cells shorted with futures-style symmetry. This declaration prices the short leg (declared borrow charge) and mandates separate long/short leg reporting.

promotion_path: Passing the bar makes a cell a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>= 100 trades AND >= 8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.

rules.atr: Wilder EWM ATR(14), alpha=1/14, adjust=False, on true range, taken at the signal session j
rules.bracket: stop = entry -/+ 2.0*ATR (long below / short above); target = entry +/- 4.0*ATR
rules.entry: open of session j+1 in the symbol's own series (pad-located; pick dropped if the symbol has no bar within 3 sessions after j)
rules.exit_management: managed from the entry session onward, entry session itself exit-checked; gap through a level fills at the session open; a level touched inside the session fills at the level; stop and target both inside one session -> stop first (worst case); time exit at the close of the 5th session counting the entry session as session 1 (reason TIME); data end -> last close (recorded as TIME by the judged engine's bracket_time path)
rules.no_lookahead: scores use closes and dividend ex-dates <= j only; entry at next session open; dividend amounts are announced before ex-dates
rules.one_position_per_symbol: a pick for a symbol with an open position is skipped (judged discipline)
rules.panel_calendar: sorted union of session dates in the verified panel; session index j is 0-based, j=0 is the first session >= 2023-01-01
rules.picks: LONG the 3 lowest scores, SHORT the 3 highest scores (k=3, as judged)
rules.ranking: ascending by score over symbols with a valid score at j; if fewer than 6 (2k) symbols have valid scores, no cohort at j
rules.score: score(s,j) = C(s,j)/C(s,j-L) - 1 + sum over s's dividend ex-dates ex in (j-L, j] of div(ex)/C(s, ex-1); C = split-adjusted close; closes forward-fill aligned to the panel calendar; a symbol whose last real close is more than 3 sessions before j has no valid score at j
rules.signal_sessions: j = 60, 65, 70, ... (warmup 60 sessions, rebalance step 5), j <= n_sessions - 2
rules.timeframe: daily bars (one bar per NYSE regular session); no intraday data

trial_accounting.expected_sample_estimate: ~180 signal cohorts over the full span, ~117 with entries in OOS, x 6 picks = ~700 OOS trades per cell before skips; W5 holdout ~100 trades. An estimate, not a promise; the verdict mapping applies whatever the actual counts are.
trial_accounting.frozen_method: per SRS holdout addendum section 5: the run re-reads the ledger at run time and judges significance at the then-final N (alpha = 0.05/N_final); a busier programme can only tighten the bar. Variants, re-runs with tweaks, a different k, a different universe or a second exit rule are additional trials under new declarations — none authorised here.

universe.selection_rule: Large US-listed common stocks: each with market capitalisation above roughly $100B at 2022-12-30, each an S&P 500 constituent continuously over the span, one ticker per issuer (dual-class issuer Alphabet represented by its more liquid class, GOOGL), purely alphabetic ticker symbols only (excludes BRK.B), each continuously listed on NYSE or Nasdaq from 2023-01-01 through 2026-10-31. The frozen ticker list is the binding artefact; the run gate verifies continuous listing and data completeness for exactly these names and reports a failure rather than substituting a name.
